quarterly_data.signal: Electronics Industry segment 1Q: orders JPY 97.9 billion against JPY 33.5 billion, of which facilities JPY 70.1 billion against JPY 6.9 billion, mainly from large-scale projects in South Korea, the United States and China. Net sales JPY 45.9 billion (facilities JPY 21.3 billion, up mainly in South Korea, Taiwan, Europe and the United States; recurring contract-based services JPY 14.5 billion on a newly launched water supply project and favorable operating conditions at customers' plants). Business profit JPY 4.1 billion against JPY 4.6 billion (margin 8.9%), on additional costs in a specific facility project and a higher facilities sales mix.
